name: Kurose Tokiko
source:
Tokiko was an office lady who lived on the same floor as Yuusuke’s apartment.

She has the appearance of a literary girl with a gloomy face and her black loosely braided hair hanging down.

Because she had been zombified, she is now Yuusuke’s toy.

[Taken and translated from the [url=http://www.spermation.net/seacoxx/zombie/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
